paragraphs.text: For a long time, forgetting was seen simply as a failure of memory. Psychologists now believe that it plays a useful role, allowing the brain to remove information that is no longer needed.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Early experiments showed that people forget most of a list of new words within a day unless they review them. Later studies found that spacing reviews over several days leads to much better long-term recall than repeating the list many times in one session.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Sleep also affects memory. Volunteers who slept after learning a set of facts remembered more of them the next morning than those who stayed awake, suggesting that the brain strengthens important memories during the night.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Stress can have the opposite effect. People who were asked to give a speech in front of strangers before a memory test recalled fewer words, although they remembered the stressful event itself very clearly.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Some researchers argue that forgetting details helps people to generalise. A child who forgets the exact appearance of every dog they have met may find it easier to recognise a new animal as a dog.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: Psychologists now believe that it plays a useful role

explanation.en: “Psychologists now believe that it plays a useful role” → B. G contradicts the text: forgetting is no longer seen as just a failure.
explanation.kk: «Psychologists now believe that it plays a useful role» → B. G мәтінге қайшы: ұмытуды енді жай ақау деп санамайды.
explanation.ru: «Psychologists now believe that it plays a useful role» → B. G противоречит тексту: забывание больше не считают просто сбоем.

items.quote: spacing reviews over several days leads to much better long-term recall

explanation.en: On reviewing: “spacing reviews over several days leads to much better long-term recall”. Reviews over several days are “spread out over time” → C.
explanation.kk: Қайталау туралы: «spacing reviews over several days leads to much better long-term recall». Күндерге бөлінген қайталау — «spread out over time» → C.
explanation.ru: О повторении сказано: «spacing reviews over several days leads to much better long-term recall». Повторы, разнесённые по дням, — это «spread out over time» → C.

items.quote: suggesting that the brain strengthens important memories during the night

explanation.en: Sleep after learning: the brain apparently “strengthens important memories during the night” → E. “Seems to” reflects “suggesting”.
explanation.kk: Оқудан кейінгі ұйқы: ми «strengthens important memories during the night» сияқты → E. «Seems to» — «suggesting» дегенді береді.
explanation.ru: Сон после учёбы: мозг, по-видимому, «strengthens important memories during the night» → E. «Seems to» передаёт «suggesting».

items.quote: People who were asked to give a speech in front of strangers before a memory test recalled fewer words

explanation.en: After stress people “recalled fewer words” → F. D is the trap: they remembered the stressful event itself “very clearly”.
explanation.kk: Күйзелістен кейін адамдар «recalled fewer words» → F. D — тұзақ: күйзеліс оқиғасының өзін, керісінше, «very clearly» есте сақтаған.
explanation.ru: После стресса люди «recalled fewer words» → F. D — ловушка: само стрессовое событие они, наоборот, помнили «very clearly».

items.quote: forgetting details helps people to generalise

explanation.en: The last paragraph: “forgetting details helps people to generalise”, as the dog example shows. “Recognise general patterns” = “generalise” → A.
explanation.kk: Соңғы абзац: «forgetting details helps people to generalise» — ит мысалы жалпыны қалай танитынын көрсетеді. «Recognise general patterns» = «generalise» → A.
explanation.ru: Последний абзац: «forgetting details helps people to generalise» — пример с собакой показывает, как узнают общее. «Recognise general patterns» = «generalise» → A.

options.text: may help people to recognise general patterns.
is now thought to have a useful purpose.
leads to better recall when it is spread out over time.
makes people remember the stressful event less clearly.
seems to help the brain keep important information.
reduced the number of words people could recall.
is always a sign of a medical problem.
